title: ⚠️ Confirmation Required Before Risky Action
description: This action may have security or data integrity implications. Review the mandatory rules below and confirm you understand them.

rules.text: Never expose secrets in source, logs, reports or browser state.
Admin APIs require explicit authentication and permission checks. Verify credentials and scope before proceeding.
Destructive operations require explicit approval. Verify the impact before confirming.
Use least privilege. Use the minimal permissions and scope necessary for the operation.
Reality before assumption. Verify the actual state before making changes. Do not invent files, tests, results, or success.
Proof before claim. Verify results with actual output, not assumptions.
No fake done. Completion without sufficient verification is not a real result.
Security and data integrity before convenience. Do not skip safety checks for speed.

systemMessage.title: Rules Acknowledgment Required
systemMessage.content: By confirming, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the rules above, and commit to following them for this action.
